_provenance.purpose: PR1 offline schema and approval vectors. Synthetic opaque v0-shaped bytes, NOT real Solana transactions; no parsing, decoder or signing-policy evidence.
_provenance.derivation: Test-only keys derived at runtime in memory: seed = sha256(UTF-8(label)); Ed25519 PKCS8 DER prefix + seed. NO private keys or seeds stored in this fixture.
_provenance.message: 0x80 prefix, header, two static keys, deterministic 32-byte label-derived blockhash, one ComputeBudget CU-limit instruction, zero ALTs.
_provenance.negativeCases: Hashes/JCS/domainBytes describe presented inputs even for invalid schema/domain. Signatures may be retained from a different mode/cluster/treasury/decision/message. expected.error is an independent reference class, not a production error-text contract.
_provenance.evm: base64Message AA== is a carrier placeholder only; EVM routeHash remains keccak256(JCS(approved tx)).
